segments.contextAfter: `reply`: A block or closure to indicate success or failure. If creation succeeds, pass the newly-created [`FSItem`](fsitem.md) and its [`FSFileName`](fsfilename.md), along with a `nil` error. If creation fails, pass the relevant error as the third parameter; FSKit ignores any [`FSItem`](fsitem.md) or [`FSFileName`](fsfilename.md) in this case. For an `async` Swift implementation, there’s no reply handler; simply return a tuple of the [`FSItem`](fsitem.md) and its [`FSFileName`](fsfilename.md) or throw an error.
